_doc: Manual judgements for tools/rescore_classify.py. 'files': impact of a changed repo file, pinned to the sha256 it was reviewed at (a later edit makes it unreviewed again). impact: none (no effect on the environment / no scoring change), env (changes what the agent works in), env_when (env change only for tasks matching 'when': initializer_ids, init_params present, or init step types). 'runs': per results dir, per task: stale_ok (why unflushed Local Storage cannot change the verdict), live_checks_carried (checks that read the live VM, carried over from the original result), replay_mismatch (why the run-time replay differs), missing_ok, env_unaffected, class/new/why (full override). Per-run notes ('runs', keyed by results dir) are kept next to each run and passed with --notes.
